title: 3259. Maximum Energy Boost From Two Drinks

examples.explanation: To gain an energy boost of 5, drink only the energy drink A (or only B).

To gain an energy boost of 7: Drink the energy drink A for the first hour. Switch to the energy drink B and we lose the energy boost of the second hour. Gain the energy boost of the drink B in the third hour.
